scripts.name: setup
scripts.command: cd "${T3CODE_WORKTREE_PATH:-$PWD}" && if [ -f package.json ]; then npm ci; fi && if [ ! -f .dev.vars ] && [ -f .dev.vars.example ]; then cp .dev.vars.example .dev.vars; fi

scripts.name: preview
scripts.command: cd "${T3CODE_WORKTREE_PATH:-$PWD}" && CLOUDFLARE_ENV=test PUBLIC_RSVP_STORE=fake npm run build && env -u CLAUDECODE CLOUDFLARE_ENV=test npm run preview -- --host 127.0.0.1
